verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Wrike publishes an llms.txt at developers.wrike.com (HTTP 200, titled "Wrike Developer Documentation"). It contains agent-readable API content such as the Batch API, attachment versioning and approvals. A second llms.txt on www.wrike.com describes the product. missing for 10: evidence of an expanded llms-full.txt or dedicated agent-oriented usage guides beyond the index, and independent user corroboration of agents consuming it effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developers.wrike.com/llms.txt # Wrike Developer Documentation Documentation
The Batch API lets you execute multiple operations asynchronously in a single request to reduce API calls and rate-limit pressure.
allowing teams to build custom AI agents that handle triaging, risk assessment, and task execution.
